entities.name: Anurag Belgudri
entities.project_description: Aria: a full‑stack multi‑agent AI assistant built with React 19, FastAPI, CrewAI, ChromaDB, Groq, and Tavily web search, using JSON‑schema enforcement to reduce hallucinations; tagent-cli: a terminal‑based AI agent published on PyPI (Python, Groq, WSL2).

project_definitions.potential_application: Using RAG with FPGA acceleration for high performance and low power consumption in the Made In India project
project_definitions.application_area: Grounding LLMs in verifiable facts to reduce hallucinations
project_definitions.optimization_target: data processing efficiency, performance and power efficiency
project_definitions.AI Agent for FPGA/CAD logs (IIT Dharwad): LangChain + CrewAI, FAISS‑based RAG, iterative reasoning, domain‑specific workflow design.
project_definitions.Prompt Optimizer Chrome Extension: Manifest V3 extension that rewrites prompts using Groq’s LLaMA 3.3 70B; backend in Node.js/Express, deployed on Render.
project_definitions.Entra Innovations: Built a LangChain / CrewAI agent that diagnoses toolchain error logs using FAISS vector retrieval.
project_definitions.MyMane: Created n8n automations that stitch together LLMs, WhatsApp/Telegram bots, and Supabase/PostgreSQL back‑ends.
project_definitions.tagent-cli: Published a command‑line tool on PyPI.
